reviews.title: Lousy support
reviews.text: I have been trying to get hold of their support as I have a free account yet I’m being charged $39.99 every month! Only way to contact them is by email, but that doesn’t really help if they don’t answer it. Beware.

reviews.title: Basic and no customer service
reviews.text: This app has the most basic features and functionality and nothing more; I’ve had free apps do more. On top of that, there’s no customer service or anyone to contact for support. I cancelled my subscription and sent emails to the email address they have listed but no response and yet they tried to charge me still. Even after I notified my bank to deny their charges, they continued to make attempts to charge my account. Do not recommend at all!

reviews.title: THIS APP IS A SCAM

There is no contact or support information AS they keep attempting to withdraw money from my bank card every few days appears to be a scambecause I can not get this cancelled. They are charging my card for different amounts!! Please STOP

reviews.title: Why
reviews.text: Hate that every app like this you have to pay to use it. I have a dying plant and this app won’t even help me to identify the plant. If I could I would give this app -1 out of 5

reviews.title: Stealing my money
reviews.text: I gave the .99 to sample this. Within an hour I sent emails to end my membership. All have gone unanswered.  Now they charge me $39.99 a month without stopping.  They say I bought it through Apple yet Apple has no record of it.

reviews.title: Not worth your time
reviews.text: This app is definitely not worth your time. I’m honestly surprised it has a 5-star rating. Almost every plant issue seems to get the same answer: “needs less water.” The information it provides is very basic and doesn’t go much beyond what most people already know. To make matters worse, if you want to ask specific questions, you’re expected to pay an additional $20. Honestly, taking a photo of your plant and asking an AI assistant gives far better and more detailed answers than this app. The biggest disappointment is that if you decide to cancel, getting your money back appears to be nearly impossible. Save your time and your money.

reviews.title: HORRIBLE COMPANY
reviews.text: I have canceled this subscription over a month ago, BUT yet you took $39.99 from my account and then again today 6/13/2026 your trying to take $39.99 from my account again! What is going on with this company because it’s incredible when someone cancels their subscription but you continue taking funds from their account and then there is NO way to contact customer support or to speak with anyone!! I want this app to be CANCELLED and if I don’t get refunded my money back into my account I will speak with an attorney next!!!

reviews.title: Customer service

reviews.title: Planty

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text:
⭐️ 1 Star If I could give zero, I would

I paid $0.99 for a “week trial”, and apparently that was my first mistake. There is no way to cancel this thing. No phone number. No confirmation email. No instructions. Nothing. I even hunted down an email listed in the app and—shocker—no reply.

So now I get to sit here knowing I’ll be auto‑enrolled into whatever mystery fees Planty decides to charge, and my bank can’t do a thing until they actually take the money. Love that for me.

This whole setup feels like a trap disguised as a “trial.” If you enjoy guessing games, disappearing customer service, and surprise charges, this is the app for you. Otherwise, run.

reviews.title: Frustrated

Every time I mark something as watered and exit the app, it pops up as needing to be watered again when I open the app. So I can’t use the app for the purpose I got it for to keep track of what’s watered. Also paid the $20 botanist fee which I thought was a one time thing for plant reviews but it’s $20 PER PLANT QUESTION. I just got my response and it’s wrong and doesn’t answer the question I have. Have emailed the support email but don’t get a response.
